programmes.programName: PhD in Logistics and Supply Chain Management (LSCM)
programmes.evidence: Official current programme explicitly names Doctor of Philosophy in Logistics and Supply Chain Management, requires original research thesis and public dissertation defense, and targets design/evaluation/optimization of complex industrial and supply-chain systems: procurement, inventory, production planning, transport, routing and reverse logistics. Current MIE division inventory explicitly lists this same PhD.
